in_sanskrit.name: Nuralam

data.cultural_impact: The name Kali refers to the Goddess Kali, who is regarded as the goddess of time, creation, destruction, power, and motherhood in Hinduism, and is often depicted with multiple arms, holding a sword and a trishula (a three-pronged weapon). She is also associated with traits like ferocity, both as a destructive force and a protector.

It symbolizes strength, courage, and resilience, and inspires devotion and awe among her followers.
